block.sanupcraft.guardian_altar.busy: A boss is already nearby (within 48 blocks).
block.sanupcraft.guardian_altar.too_cold: Too cold here. The Furnace Warden only wakes in the Nether.
advancements.sanupcraft.root.title: Sanupcraft
advancements.sanupcraft.root.description: Factories open boss fights, bosses open factories. Start by mining iron.
advancements.sanupcraft.rusted_shrine.de: Find a Rusted Shrine in plains or forests. Its chest holds a Guardian Summoner
advancements.sanupcraft.crusher.title: Double and More
advancements.sanupcraft.crusher.descript: Raw ore → 2 dust, sometimes another metal. Crush coal too (steel ingredient). Next, a Press (5 iron ingots, a piston, 3 cobblestone). Hoppers: top input, side fuel, bottom output.
advancements.sanupcraft.iron_plate.title: Parts Bin
advancements.sanupcraft.iron_plate.descr: An Assembler turns steel plates into machine parts.
advancements.sanupcraft.steel.title: Rustproof
advancements.sanupcraft.steel.descriptio: A full steel set blocks rust attacks. Place a Guardian Altar and right-click it with a Summoning Stone to wake the Rusty Guardian (the stone is used up).
advancements.sanupcraft.guardian_core.de: One core = one Reinforced Machine Frame, or 4 core shards in a Crusher. Frames and shards go into many things, so expect to hunt the guardian several times.
advancements.sanupcraft.boiler.title: Full Steam
advancements.sanupcraft.boiler.descripti: Pour in a water bucket or place it next to a water source, then add fuel. Machines on the pipes run without fuel. Empty-hand right-click: status.
advancements.sanupcraft.belt_motor.title: Assembly Line
advancements.sanupcraft.belt_motor.descr: A motor runs the belts it touches (up to 32). Belts carry toward their front and insert into the chest or machine at the end. Sneaking stops you from being pushed.
advancements.sanupcraft.heatproof.title: Fireproof
advancements.sanupcraft.heatproof.descri: Heatproof = steel gear + machine parts + core shards (enchantments are lost). It still blocks rust attacks, and a full set resists fire and lava. Find blaze rods in a Nether fortress.
The Furnace Warden only wakes in the heat of the Nether. Build an altar there. Nether fortress chests may hold one too.
advancements.sanupcraft.warden_heart.des: Defeat the Furnace Warden. Its heart builds a Heart Forge.
advancements.sanupcraft.heart_forge.desc: Ancient debris → 2 netherite scrap, blaze rod → 4 blaze powder. Craft eyes of ender and head for the End.
advancements.sanupcraft.shulker_shell.de: Shulker shells from End cities make Ender Senders and Receivers.
advancements.sanupcraft.ender_link.title: Across Dimensions
advancements.sanupcraft.ender_link.descr: Dye a sender (needs a Warden's Heart) and a receiver the same color. Items cross dimensions, but the receiver side must be loaded (an ender anchor can keep it loaded).
advancements.sanupcraft.raw_iron.title: Iron Age
advancements.sanupcraft.raw_iron.descrip: Mine raw iron. A Crusher (3 iron ingots, 2 flint, 4 cobblestone) turns it into 2 dust plus byproducts.
advancements.sanupcraft.alloy.title: Not in Vanilla
advancements.sanupcraft.alloy.descriptio: Steel! Armor set 24 · hammer 6 · sword 2 (1 steel = 1 raw iron + 1 coal). Press steel into plates, then assemble machine parts.
advancements.sanupcraft.hammer.title: Nine at Once
advancements.sanupcraft.hammer.descripti: Digs 3x3 (sneak for one block). 60% speed, and much harder blocks are left behind.
advancements.sanupcraft.quarry.title: The Ground Digs Itself
advancements.sanupcraft.quarry.descripti: Steam from pipes, a chest or belt on top. It digs the 9x9 below down to the bottom, so watch your step. Blocks an iron pickaxe cannot mine are left alone.
advancements.sanupcraft.press.title: Plate Maker
advancements.sanupcraft.press.descriptio: Press: iron ingot → iron plate. Alloy Smelter = 6 iron plates + 2 furnaces + blast furnace.
block.sanupcraft.guardian_altar.no_room: Not enough room: clear 3x3 and 4 blocks high above the altar.
block.sanupcraft.guardian_altar.peaceful: Bosses do not wake on Peaceful.
entity.sanupcraft.rusty_guardian.rust_wa: Rusted! Without a full steel set you take 1.5x damage and slowness.
entity.sanupcraft.furnace_warden.heat_wa: Overheated! Without a full heatproof set you take 1.5x damage and burn.
block.sanupcraft.boiler.other_fuel: It holds a different fuel. You can only add the same fuel.
block.sanupcraft.boiler.hint.no_water: No water: pour a bucket or place it next to a water source
block.sanupcraft.boiler.hint.steam_full: Steam full: it only burns fuel as steam is used

block.sanupcraft.steam_quarry.void_off: Junk voiding off: everything mined goes up

block.sanupcraft.steam_quarry.drill_alre: A heatproof drill is already installed

block.sanupcraft.ender_anchor.tooltip: 1 popped chorus fruit = 10 min · keeps the 3x3 chunks around it loaded
block.sanupcraft.ender_anchor.tooltip2: Keeps an unattended Nether outpost and ender receivers running
You cannot place water in the Nether. Put a geothermal vent next to lava sources for steam without water or fuel — power for a Nether outpost.
A quarry with a heatproof drill mines ancient debris. Set one deep in the Nether (Y 8-22) and send the loot home with an ender sender.
advancements.sanupcraft.ender_anchor.des: Build an ender anchor with dragon's breath. Fed popped chorus fruit, it keeps a Nether outpost running with nobody there.
